notes: Among the above 23 States/UTs, Uttar Pradesh had allocated the highest outlay of Rs.5882.64
lakhs in the budget for the various prisons in the State. This was followed by Bihar (Rs.4262.62 lakhs),
Maharashtra (Rs.3728.41 lakhs) and Tamil Nadu (Rs.3485.29 lakhs). In Dadra & Nagar Haveli, a
meagre sum of Rs.1.72 lakhs only had been provided as annual budget for functioning of jails in the
As is generally known, expenditure allocated for specific planned activities of short term
- durations within a period of Five Year Plan are termed as Planned Expenditure while expenditure made
on meeting day-to-day expenses and for running an establishment like payment of salaries, wages, rent
etc, come under the category of Non-Planned Expenditure. Non-Plan Expenditure may also involve
activities for development of existing infrastructures and bringing about improvements in the Prisons.
